_about: The training plan the app's planner and the bot's coaching use. strength_days_per_week, cardio_per_week and the daily sleep and step bands come from health/settings.json (the onboarding sets them); the rest is a sensible general plan you can ask Claude to change. gym, injuries and phase_note are free text the bot reads when it coaches.
gym: a commercial gym: dumbbells, barbells and racks, cables, plate and pin machines
cardio: a run, ride or row on separate days
phase_note: Build strength steadily: add reps, then weight. Stop 1-3 reps short of failure on compounds.
logging: Tap in the health app; the bot also takes text, voice and gym-app screenshots
